measurement_boundary: Record actual effort for the enrolled unit. Wall-clock time includes waiting within the active work session; active time estimates direct researcher/tooling effort. Corrections count substantive rework, not spelling edits.
measurement_rules: A COMPLETE phase requires numeric nonnegative wall_clock_seconds and active_seconds.
NOT_STARTED and IN_PROGRESS phases may retain null timing rather than inventing precision.
A BLOCKED phase may retain null timing only if notes explain what prevented completion.
correction_count is always an integer greater than or equal to zero.
primary_result_frozen may become true only after verification_runtime is COMPLETE.
rule: Do not backfill fictitious precision. If timing was not measured, record null with an explicit note and treat the ledger as incomplete rather than inventing a duration. Automation decisions belong after repeated observations across units.
